title: Reduce bore scrap on VB-2210
business_case: Bore scrap and rework on VB-2210 cost GBP 86k in FY2026 and caused 2 customer complaints; supports the plant objective of scrap < 1.5%.
problem_statement: From January to September 2026, 3.1% of VB-2210 valve bodies machined on lathes 1-4 were scrapped or reworked for bore diameter outside 12.000-12.018 mm, versus 0.8% on similar parts.
goal_statement: Reduce VB-2210 bore scrap and rework from 3.1% to 0.8% by 2027-04-30 without increasing cycle time.
secondary_metric: OP20 cycle time must stay <= 94 s

scope.in: OP20 finish boring on lathes 1-4, all shifts
